title: ClearPath Good-Standing Retainage on Professional Services Projects Milestones
content:
Retainage on Professional Services Projects milestone invoices is extended to clients in good standing on ClearPath Managed IT Services.

A client with ClearPath billing that shows no late fee posted in the twelve months before the invoice date has 2.5 percent of the milestone invoice withheld as retainage, one whose ClearPath billing shows exactly one such late fee 1.0 percent, and any other client none, including a client with no ClearPath billing at all.

A late fee counts toward a twelve-month window when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posted date from the invoice date, a whole month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.

| Client's ClearPath billing | ClearPath late fees posted in the twelve months | Retainage |
|---|---|---|
| has ClearPath billing | none | 2.5 percent of the milestone invoice |
| has ClearPath billing | exactly one | 1.0 percent of the milestone invoice |
| has ClearPath billing | two or more | none |
| no ClearPath billing at all | not applicable | none |

Any ClearPath billing entry counts as ClearPath billing, whatever its kind and whatever the status of the agreement.

Hypothetical illustration: a client whose ClearPath billing holds only an onboarding fee and a payment, with no late fee, has 2.5 percent withheld.
